Li, G.S., Walenta, G. and Gartner, E.M. (2007). Formation and hydration of low-CO2 cements based on belite, calcium sulfoaluminate and calcium aluminoferrite. Proceedings of the 12th International Congress on the Chemistry of Cement (ICCC), Montreal, July 2007. Lafarge Central Research, Saint Quentin Fallavier.

Lafarge laboratory study of belite-sulfoaluminate-ferrite (BCSAF, later Aether) cement. Loaded: description, laboratory status, 1300 degC clinkering, 20-30% total CO2 reduction vs OPC, gypsum 8-12% (flows), and the 0.53 t CO2/t OPC clinker decarbonation figure (reprinted from Gartner 2004). Hydration chemistry, XRD, calorimetry and strength curves not loaded. No energy use per tonne, cost, capacity or lifetime. The held copy has no printed page numbers: locators are PDF pages (1-12).
